passages.text: Geometry is a branch of mathematics concerned with questions of shape, size, relative position of figures, and the properties of space. Geometry is one of the oldest mathematical sciences. Modern geometry also extends into non-Euclidean spaces, topology, and fractal dimensions, bridging pure mathematics with applications in physics, computer science, and data visualization.

Van Hiele model - Prevailing theory of how children learn to reason in geometry
The Strähle construction is used in the design of some musical instruments.
Burmester's theory for the design of mechanical linkages
